mapper.select: SELECT M.MENU_ID, M.PARENT_MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_TYPE, M.MENU_PATH, M.SORT_NO, M.USE_YN, NVL(AM.QRY_ROL_YN, 'N') AS QRY_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.REG_ROL_YN, 'N') AS REG_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.UPD_ROL_YN, 'N') AS UPD_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.DEL_ROL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_ROL_YN, NVL(AM.EXE_ROL_YN, 'N') AS EXE_ROL_YN FROM TB_SCR_MENU M LEFT JOIN TB_SCR_AUTH_MENU AM ON AM.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND AM.AUTH = #{auth} AND AM.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SORT_NO, M.MENU_ID
